title: A "none of these" answer with a clear note closes the item and becomes a step
why: Owner, Nov 1 17:44 CST, forwarding a home repo session's finding: the gap is in every repo, not only home.
note: Shape: when the owner answers "none of these" with a note that gives a clear direction, the item closes and the note becomes a step, instead of the item being asked again. Incident: home's triage re-asked items 48 and 49 after clear notes. Departs from: skill waiting-page treats "none" as no ruling (it never picks an option); this changes that rule, so the lane updates the skill and its record. Ready: no open question.
